Hi all,

We just had a calendar change from the recruiter at Taliesin — Olivia Green (final stage, ML Lead) is now available for two interview blocks next week and we need a quick fallback plan in case some panelists can’t make it. Details:

- Candidate: Olivia Green (resume attached)
- Role: Machine Learning Lead (infra + model reliability focus)
- Preferred interview windows (candidate local TZ PST): Tue 3/23 14:00–16:00 or Wed 3/24 11:00–13:00
- Interview mix: system design (90m), coding deep‑dive (60m), debrief (30m)

Ask: can you indicate which slot you can commit to as primary and whether you can be a standby backup for the other? If you can’t do either, suggest one internal backup. We need firm confirmations by EOD today so James (recruiter) can lock the times.

Fallback rules I want to follow:
1) If primary drops within 24h, standby takes the slot.
2) If standby also unavailable, escalate to the cross‑team standby pool (Jonas or an infra PM).
3) For any gaps >30m we’ll convert the session to a shorter focused interview rather than reschedule.

Attachments: Olivia_Green_Resume.pdf; I added a panel_availability.ics with tentative blocks.

Thanks — Monica
